question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH top3_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ORDER BY AVG(op.payment_value) DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as order_count,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order,
        MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)) as latest_date,
        MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)) as earliest_date,
        (MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE))) as days_diff
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top3_customers)
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    order_count,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN days_diff < 7 THEN 1.0
        ELSE days_diff / 7.0
    END as lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
